messages:
Sam (sales): Aurelia Health asked for a perf POC: sustain 200 qps, 99p < 350ms end-to-end, multi-region failover, and per-request cost estimates. Can we run next week?
Alicia (sales): They also flagged PHI + SOC2, KMS requirement. Timeline: 3d baseline + 2d stress.
Maria (SE): Need model details and token counts. Chat or single-turn?
Sam (sales): Single-turn summarization. Avg input ~1200 tokens, output ~120 tokens.
Lina (eng): With that token size 200 qps is non-trivial. Do they require streaming? Also clarify if 99p is first-token or full response.
Sam (sales): Full response.
Owen (sre): Multi-region means we'll test cold-start failover. KMS unwrap per init may add latency; we should measure.
Maria (SE): Perf plan draft:
- Smoke (1h): 10 qps single-region correctness.
- Ramp (3h): linear to 200 qps across 2 AZs, sample p50/p95/p99.
- Soak (6h): sustain 200 qps, monitor KV cache, mem, tails.
- Spike/failover: 5m 500 qps while cutting region to test routing.
Artifacts: runner logs, per-request traces, CSV metrics.
Maria (SE): Runner example:
perf-runner --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --concurrency 10 --ramp 3m --duration 1m --payload-file sample_payload.json --auth-token $KEY
Maria (SE): sample payload: { "model": "open-redwood-7b", "input": "<clinical notes>", "max_tokens": 150 }
Lina (eng): Test with/without prefix/KV cache and a quantized medium model variant. Cache will change 99p a lot. Also reserve capacity to avoid GPU queueing at tail.
Sam (sales): Pricing: Aurelia wants delta for quantized + cache vs baseline.
Lina (eng): Rough ballpark: uncached baseline for this scale ~ $0.045 per 1k output tokens. With prefix cache + 8-bit quant variant expect 45-60% cost reduction steady-state. For 200 qps * 120 out tokens -> ~864M tokens/day uncached; effective could drop to ~300M/day with cache.
Owen (sre): If they insist on per-request HSM unwrap, add ~12-18ms. That could push 99p over target on cold misses; recommend session key caching.
DeployBot: loadtest-started: thread=5472001111 run_id=run-2026-06-10-02 region=us-west-2
Maria (SE): Early ramp results (12m sample): p50=92ms, p95=165ms, p99=385ms, errors 0.3%. 99p correlated with KV misses and occasional GPU queue spikes.
Lina (eng): Two mitigations: enable prefix cache (expected -80ms on 99p) and fallback to quantized-medium for tails. Also bump reserved GPUs.
Maria (SE): With prefix cache enabled: p50=90ms, p95=145ms, p99=300ms, errors 0.12%. Cache hit rate ~70%. Meets 99p <350ms.
Sam (sales): Can we capture cost delta for proposals?
Maria (SE): Quick estimated daily cost from runs:
- No-cache standard model: est tokens/day 864M -> est cost/day ~$38,800.
- Cache + quant variant: est effective tokens/day 300M -> est cost/day ~$15,000. Will provide formal quote numbers.
Owen (sre): Multi-region failover test showed 30-45s window of increased latency during cold replica ramp. Recommend warm standby + traffic cutover policy.
Alicia (sales): Request: SEs produce 2-page exec summary + appendix with commands/metrics and recommended configs for Dedicated vs Hosted. Procurement wants both tech + cost.
Maria (SE): I'll draft summary and attach CSVs (EOD tomorrow). Lina will add reserved capacity sizing and burst buffer recommendation. Owen will add security/KMS notes and session-key mitigation doc (72h).
Sam (sales): Thanks team. I'll schedule a 30m recap with Aurelia for Wed.
Maria (SE): ack :thumbsup:
Lina (eng): ack
Owen (sre): ack
Sam (sales): thanks, closing loop.
